title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1966-10-31

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a short, well‑recorded instrumental jam that sounds great but is not a Grateful Dead performance.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers clear, crisp audio of an about five‑minute instrumental tease, which several reviewers praised as sounding excellent. However, the consensus is that the music does not resemble the Dead at all – different guitar phrasing, bass line and tempo lead listeners to identify it as likely a one‑off group such as Anonymous Artists of America rather than the Grateful Dead.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers agree the performance is not by the Dead (poor show quality) while noting the audio itself is clear and well‑recorded; weighted average yields a low overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean sound with no reported dropouts or mix issues; reviewers mention "5 star sound" for the instrumental jam.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only a brief ~5‑minute instrumental tease is present; not a full set and does not reflect typical Dead pacing or song structure.
